slides.texte_overlay:
habits that will make you
unreasonably confident

packing tomorrow tonight

every evening, lay out tomorrow's clothes and write down the first task of the day. waking up with no decisions to make is the calmest way to start, and calm reads as confidence.

full sentence replies

for a week, answer messages in full, clear sentences instead of "ok" and "lol". the way you write is how people imagine you sound, so sound like someone sure of themselves.

the sunday question

every sunday, take a 30 minute walk alone and ask yourself one question: what did i avoid this week? the honest answer is usually next week's plan, written for you.

lunch break lessons

use 5 minutes of your lunch break to learn something new: an artist, an invention, a piece of history. small daily lessons make you the person everyone wants to sit next to.

voice training

read one page out loud every morning, slowly, a little lower than your normal voice. a calm, steady voice is a habit, and people trust it before you've even finished your sentence.
